name: Screenshot
description: Screen capture, scrolling capture, screen recording (up to 60 min or 2 GB), and local OCR text extraction for Lookout.
summary: Capture, scroll-capture, record, and extract text from your screen; mark up, copy or save.
approval_note: Captures screen areas, scrolling pages, records screen video (up to 60 min or 2 GB), and extracts text using local Windows.Media.Ocr (offline, no network) to clipboard or screenshots folder. Uses GDI BitBlt capture: black frames possible for GPU/DRM content; high CPU at 1080p60+.
